_note: P5 THE VOICE PASS — E.V. REGISTER (the VULCAN voice register). The single home for every FIXED spoken string in VULCAN. LAW for anything VULCAN says on its own initiative — statuses, confirmations, redirects, failures, situational lines. Register rules, applied to every line here: (1) short conversational sentences — one or two, never a paragraph; (2) SECOND PERSON — talk to the operator ('you', 'your'), never about 'the user'; (3) LEAD WITH THE ANSWER — the useful word first, the caveat after; (4) ONE-BREATH STATUSES — a status line is sayable in a single breath. {vars} interpolate at call time via register.line(key, vars). Dynamic answers (a real brain reply, a wire briefing) are NOT here — only fixed strings. Keep tokens.json and this file in step: session/intent tokens that are spoken mirror these keys.

lines.muted: Muted. Hold the trigger when you want me.
lines.stopped.working: Stopped. That job is cancelled — nothing left the machine.
lines.autoDormant: Banking the fire. Say Fire and Forge when you need me.
lines.fallback: I didn't catch that. Say it again, or ask me for the mission brief.
lines.redirect: Hold the trigger and say Fire and Forge to wake me.
lines.hold: {verb} leaves the machine. Say confirm to go ahead, or cancel to hold.
lines.noHand: I don't have a hand for that one yet, so nothing left the machine.
lines.clarify: I didn't catch a command. Try a deck command, or ask me a question.
lines.dispatchFailed: {cmd} couldn't run. Nothing left the machine.
lines.status: Here's the read. Voice is {voice}, and the wire is {wire}.
lines.testVoice: I'm online. Your voice link sounds good.
lines.waitlistSet: Waitlist is at {n} now, marked manual.
lines.vercelSaved: Vercel token saved locally. Nothing left the machine.
lines.situational.spend: Heads up — you're at {pct} percent of today's Claude budget.
